sources.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman postpones visit to S. Korea
sources.snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has postponed a visit to South Korea scheduled for next week, citing personal reasons. He was due to meet Samsung Electronics executives to discuss AI cooperation.

sources.title: Samsung AI chip talks with OpenAI stall
sources.snippet: Samsung Electronics had prepared a multi-day schedule for Altman at its Suwon campus, including discussions on custom AI chip development. The postponement leaves the timeline for a potential chip partnership in limbo.

angle.headline: Altman Postpones South Korea Trip, Leaving Samsung Chip Talks in Limbo
angle.angle: Sam Altman's postponement disrupts AI chip partnership discussions with Samsung Electronics.
angle.rationale: The postponement stalls chip cooperation talks that Samsung had scheduled at its Suwon campus.
